instructions.question: What emotional attitude does the poster of this Croatian tweet convey, judged from the tweet's tone and from the valence of what it reports or shares?
instructions.rule: Annotators label even bare headlines and links by the valence of their subject. Bad news, problems, complaints, mockery, sarcasm or teasing count as negative even with a smiley. Promotions, wins, greetings, recommendations, shared music or videos and pleasant check-ins count as positive. Neutral is only for plain facts, questions, banter or announcements that carry no clear good or bad feeling.

neutral.what: Factual information, statistics, plain questions, personal remarks without clear emotion, light chat, and news stated without evaluation.
examples: šta si popodne ovaj tjedan? (what shift are you this week?)
Milanović: Ministri će koristiti manje skupe automobile (Ministers will use less expensive cars)
[#LIVE] 75' Iz igre je izašao Pjaca, u igri je Ćorić. (Pjaca off, Ćorić on)
neutral.cues: questions, numbers, match substitutions, location tags, 'saznajte' (find out), 'pogledajte' (look)
neutral.not_for: Headlines about deaths, crises, unemployment or scandals go negative. Wins, offers and greetings go positive.

positive.what: Joy, praise, thanks, excitement or greetings. Also shared content with an upbeat topic: sports goals and wins, events, offers, travel, liked or added videos, check-ins.
examples: Bravo dečki! Slovačka je doslovce potopljena! (Bravo boys! Slovakia is literally sunk!)
Godišnji na vidiku. Ne mogu dočekati. (Vacation in sight. Can't wait.)
Sviđa mi se videozapis http://t.co/yfVD8U3P5u (I like a video)
positive.cues: hvala (thanks), bravo, sretan (happy), dobro jutro (good morning), GOOOL (goal), odlična (excellent), za samo (for only), :)
positive.not_for: Smileys attached to teasing, mocking or complaining go negative. Neutral facts about events with no enthusiasm go neutral.

negative.what: Annoyance, dislike, sadness, worry, sarcasm, mockery or insults. Also news or links about bad events: accidents, deaths, recession, protests, traffic jams, missing people, scandals.
examples: Nisam gadljiv, al mrzim ovo (I'm not squeamish, but I hate this)
Nestao je Radelić Dario! (Dario Radelić has gone missing!)
@LucijaCavric oho i ovdje si finjak :P (oho, you're being posh here too)
negative.cues: mrzim (I hate), smeće (trash), glupost (nonsense), poginuo (killed), nezaposlenost (unemployment), recesija (recession), gužve (crowds), noćna mora (nightmare), :(
negative.not_for: Neutral informational posts that merely mention a topic such as jobs or politics go neutral. Self-deprecating jokes that are clearly cheerful go positive.
